items.title_zh: 全球湿地开垦带来的农业收益有限，但洪水风险较高
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 09 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01965-xAs food demand increases, global wetlands are being reclaimed as croplands; however, these reclaimed croplands are not only less productive, but also face substantially higher flood exposure. This dual vulnerability highlights the urgency of balancing food security with wetland conservation.

items.title: Global patterns and trends in event-scale runoff generation reveal disproportionate declines in arid catchments
items.title_en: Global patterns and trends in event-scale runoff generation reveal disproportionate declines in arid catchments
items.title_zh: 事件尺度径流形成的全球模式与趋势表明，干旱流域的径流减少幅度尤为显著
items.summary_en: Event-scale rainfall-runoff analyses improve understanding of runoff generation processes and efficiencies, complementing long-term analyses. We present the first uncertainty-aware global synthesis of event-scale runoff generation, which is quantified by events occurrences, typical runoff coefficients, and their full empirical distributions across individual catchments. Across the regions with available gauged data, event runoff coefficients are substantially less than the long-term runoff coefficients, with median event runoff coefficients reaching only 10% of the corresponding long-term values in less than 4% of catchments. This gap reflects the temporal aggregation of event-scale rainfall-runoff conversion, potentially incorporating fundamental flow-partitioning processes including delayed subsurface and groundwater flows. Event runoff occurrences and generation efficiencies vary systematically with aridity, shifting from mostly no-runoff and low-efficiency generation in arid catchments to efficient runoff generation in humid catchments. Although most catchments show non-significant trends, significant declines in runoff occurrences and event runoff coefficients are disproportionately concentrated in arid regions, affecting up to 13% arid catchments. These regions also exhibit the largest magnitudes of decreases across both metrics, highlighting water scarcity risks in the world’s driest regions.
items.summary_zh: 降雨-径流事件尺度分析有助于加深对径流形成过程及效率的理解，是对长期分析的有效补充。本文首次提出了考虑不确定性的全球性事件尺度径流形成综合分析，该分析通过各流域的降雨事件发生频率、典型径流系数及其完整的经验分布进行了量化。 在拥有水文观测数据的各区域中，降雨事件径流系数远低于长期径流系数，在不到4%的流域中，降雨事件径流系数的中位数仅达到相应长期值的10%。 这一差距反映了事件尺度降雨-径流转换的时间聚合效应，可能涉及包括延迟的地下水和地下水流在内的基本流量分配过程。 事件径流的发生频率和生成效率随干湿程度呈现系统性变化，从干旱流域中大多无径流和低生成效率，到湿润流域中高效的径流生成。 尽管大多数流域未显示出显著趋势，但径流发生频率和降雨径流系数的显著下降在干旱地区尤为集中，影响范围高达13%的干旱流域。这些地区在两项指标上的下降幅度也最大，凸显了全球最干旱地区面临的水资源短缺风险。

items.title: Decoupling the cost estimations and equity implications of decarbonisation from carbon pricing
items.title_en: Decoupling the cost estimations and equity implications of decarbonisation from carbon pricing
items.title_zh: 将脱碳的成本估算及其对股权的影响与碳定价脱钩
items.summary_en: Existing long-term climate mitigation scenarios typically rely on carbon pricing to estimate macroeconomic impacts and equity implications of decarbonisation, often projecting adverse distributional outcomes. However, substantial emissions reduction can also be achieved through non-carbon-pricing measures, raising concerns about the insights of these scenarios. Here, we decoupled the cost and equity assessment of decarbonisation from carbon pricing by developing decarbonisation scenarios independent of carbon pricing. We found that while the macroeconomic cost mainly comes from the system transition, the distributional effects indicated in conventional carbon-price-based scenarios are mainly caused by carbon prices, contributing to increases on poverty, hunger risks, and domestic income inequality by 86%, 84%, and 90%, respectively. Our findings indicate the great potential to moderate the concerns on the equity implications of climate change mitigation associated with carbon pricing and the need for improved policy representations in scenarios to better inform equitable and sustainable decarbonisation transitions.
items.summary_zh: 现有的长期气候减缓情景通常依赖碳定价来估算脱碳对宏观经济的影响及其公平性问题，往往预测会出现不利的收入分配结果。然而，通过非碳定价措施同样可以实现大幅减排，这引发了人们对这些情景分析结果的质疑。 在此，我们通过构建独立于碳定价的脱碳情景，将脱碳的成本与公平性评估从碳定价中分离出来。 我们发现，虽然宏观经济成本主要源于系统转型，但传统基于碳定价的情景中显示的收入分配效应主要由碳价格引起，分别导致贫困、饥饿风险和国内收入不平等加剧86%、84%和90%。 我们的研究结果表明，在缓解人们对碳定价所引发的气候变化减缓措施公平性影响的担忧方面存在巨大潜力，同时也表明有必要改进情景分析中的政策表述，以更好地为公平且可持续的脱碳转型提供决策依据。

items.title: The cost of regulatory delay: quantifying how permitting timelines affect offshore wind energy costs
items.title_en: The cost of regulatory delay: quantifying how permitting timelines affect offshore wind energy costs
items.title_zh: 监管延误的成本：量化许可审批时限对海上风电成本的影响
items.summary_en: Rapid deployment of offshore renewable energy and transmission infrastructure can be a major contributor to energy system decarbonization. However, regulatory obligations frequently impose deployment delays that are typically not quantified in cost terms. The costs of such delays should be incorporated in project and technology assessments. Here, a framework is developed that treats the development lag between project inception and operation as a temporal proxy for regulatory and related obligations, and propagates it through a levelized-cost-of-energy calculation to quantify the cost of delay. This framework is used to compare, on a common basis, conventional high-voltage cable transmission with offshore power-to-hydrogen (PtH) alternatives. The framework is applied to three strategies to move energy to shore from offshore wind facilities. The results show that for an example, one gigawatt plant, deploying one year sooner can save €110 million—a relevant metric to gauge the cost of policy designed to expedite deployment. In scenarios where the PtH can be deployed faster than high-voltage cables, the results suggest a limited decision space in which PtH transmission is cheaper, indicating that it will need to realize other benefits to compete with high-voltage cable transmission on cost. Profitability between electricity-based and hydrogen-based transmission is then compared, considering differences in deployment time. There are existing conditions of hydrogen and electricity prices that indicate PtH pathways may be more profitable when a difference in deployment lag is applied. In the example considered here, a lag difference can result in a greater number of exploratory price scenarios where PtH is more profitable. This framework is useful to quantify the implications of regulatory obligations and tune policies to accelerate low-carbon energy deployment.
items.summary_zh: 海上可再生能源及输电基础设施的快速部署，可为能源系统的脱碳进程作出重大贡献。然而，监管义务往往导致部署延迟，而这些延迟通常未以成本形式进行量化。此类延迟的成本应纳入项目和技术评估中。 本文构建了一个评估框架，将项目启动至投运之间的开发滞后期视为监管及相关义务的时间代理变量，并通过平准化能源成本（LCOE）计算将其纳入考量，从而量化延迟所产生的成本。 利用该框架，可在统一基准下对传统高压电缆输电与海上电解制氢（PtH）方案进行比较。 该框架被应用于三种将海上风电设施的能源输送至岸上的策略。结果表明，以一座1吉瓦的电厂为例，若能提前一年投运，可节省1.1亿欧元——这一指标对于衡量旨在加快部署的政策成本具有重要参考价值。 在PtH部署速度快于高压电缆的情景下，结果表明PtH输电成本更低的决策空间有限，这表明PtH需要在成本上实现其他效益，才能与高压电缆输电竞争。随后，在考虑部署时间差异的基础上，对基于电力和基于氢能的输电方案的盈利能力进行了比较。 现有氢气和电价条件表明，当考虑部署滞后差异时，PtH路径可能更具盈利性。 在本研究考虑的示例中，部署滞后差异可产生更多探索性价格情景，在这些情景下，PtH的盈利能力更强。该框架有助于量化监管义务的影响，并调整政策以加速低碳能源的部署。

items.title: Spatiotemporal shifts in composite weather stress across US croplands
items.title_en: Spatiotemporal shifts in composite weather stress across US croplands
items.title_zh: 美国农田复合气象胁迫的时空变化
items.summary_en: Weather stressors influence crop production, farm management, and long-term agricultural suitability across the United States. These stressors vary across agricultural regions. While numerous weather indices exist, a generalized metric tailored to a region’s specific agricultural context remains lacking. Here, we introduce a multi-stressor framework that integrates 32 weather-based stress indicators representing compound drought, flood, extreme heat, cold, and thermal accumulation events across the Contiguous United States (CONUS) from 1980 to 2023. The framework applies an Agro-Ecological Zones-specific weighted averaging scheme that minimizes index redundancy while assigning region-specific importance to individual stressors. We then use a spatiotemporal analog tracking approach to characterize shifts in weather stress relative to a historical baseline period. This approach produces two composite metrics—weather stress divergence and weather stress similarity—quantifying deviations of current weather stress from, and spatial correspondence with, the historical baseline, respectively. To evaluate relevance, we examine their association with county-scale detrended yield anomalies for corn, soybeans, and wheat. Yield anomalies are negatively associated with weather stress divergence, with higher values indicating greater departures from historical conditions, and positively associated with weather stress similarity in a subset of counties. More than 50% of the CONUS cropland area experienced increasing weather stress divergence, primarily driven by drought and extreme heat, while weather stress similarity declined across many croplands. The most pronounced spatial analog shifts are concentrated in eastern agricultural regions, highlighting a growing loss of correspondence between current weather regimes and historical baselines. Although technological advances and adaptive management have contributed to long-term yield improvements, compound weather stress metrics explain measurable components of interannual yield variability. The proposed framework provides a systematic, region-specific approach to benchmark compound weather stress exposure and support agricultural risk assessment and planning from farm to national scales.
items.summary_zh: 天气应激因素影响着全美范围内的作物产量、农场管理以及长期农业适宜性。这些应激因素在不同农业区域之间存在差异。尽管现有的天气指数众多，但仍缺乏一种针对特定地区农业背景量身定制的通用评估指标。 本文提出了一种多胁迫因子框架，整合了32项基于天气的胁迫指标，这些指标代表了1980年至2023年间美国本土48州（CONUS）范围内发生的复合干旱、洪涝、极端高温、极端低温及热量累积事件。 该框架采用针对农业生态区（Agro-Ecological Zones）的加权平均方案，在为各压力因子赋予区域特异性权重的同时，最大限度地减少了指数冗余。 随后，我们采用时空类比追踪方法，以描述相对于历史基准时期的气象胁迫变化。该方法产生了两个综合指标——气象胁迫偏离度和气象胁迫相似度——分别量化了当前气象胁迫与历史基准的偏差及其空间对应关系。 为评估其相关性，我们考察了这些指标与玉米、大豆和小麦在县一级的去趋势产量异常值之间的关联。产量异常值与气象胁迫偏离呈负相关（数值越高表明与历史条件偏差越大），而在部分县中则与气象胁迫相似性呈正相关。 美国本土（CONUS）超过50%的耕地面积出现了天气压力差异的加剧，这主要由干旱和极端高温驱动；与此同时，许多耕地的天气压力相似性则有所下降。 最显著的空间类比变化集中于东部农业地区，这凸显了当前天气模式与历史基准之间对应关系的日益减弱。尽管技术进步和适应性管理促进了长期产量的提高，但复合天气压力指标却
